mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_stock_investor ( stock_code, bsop_date, close_price, individual_net_buy, foreign_net_buy, institution_net_buy, volume, created_at ) VALUES ( #{stockCode}, #{bsopDate}, #{closePrice}, #{individualNetBuy}, #{foreignNetBuy}, #{institutionNetBuy}, #{volume}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE close_price = #{closePrice}, individual_net_buy = #{individualNetBuy}, foreign_net_buy = #{foreignNetBuy}, institution_net_buy = #{institutionNetBuy}, volume = #{volume}, created_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_code as stockCode, price_at_recom as priceAtRecom FROM ai_next_leaders WHERE hit_result = 'PENDING' AND captured_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY)
